description: RED VIAL ADMINISTRADA POR EL DEPARTAMENTO DE BOYACÁ is a dataset listed in Colombian national open data portal (datos.gov.co), an open data portal (Socrata), published or maintained by Gobernación de Boyacá, Boyacá. Incluye únicamente la Red vial administrada por el Departamento de Boyacá (no incluye la red vial en el departamento administrada por la nación y por los municipios). De acuerdo al Decreto 1895 de 2008 por medio del cual se determina la red vial a cargo del Departamento de Boyará. Coverage: Gobernación de Boyacá, Boyacá. The portal files it under the publisher Gobernación de Boyacá, Boyacá. Its tags are vias, infraestructura. It offers 2 resource(s) in CSV, JSON. The portal files it under the category Ordenamiento Territorial. The portal shows 2024-08-26 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-SA-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-datos-gov-co-portal.
